summary.text: Angie O'Steen is a Republican state representative who has represented Georgia House District 169 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse and family farmer, she succeeded Clay Pirkle in the seat.

paragraphs.text: O'Steen's career experience includes working as a registered nurse and family farmer.
O'Steen defeated William Roberts in the May 21, 2024 Republican primary for House District 169 and Theresa Rewis in the November 2024 general election, taking office on January 13, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Agriculture and Consumer Affairs, Public and Community Health, and Rural Development committees.
